apps.next: 21 NOV, THE DOOR READS A PHOTO (#556, house v77) — WAITING ON ONE REDEPLOY. Jerry photographed a Menards receipt in Business Manager and Tesseract, the reader that runs on the phone, garbled the thermal print; relayed here by the front door from the Truck & Trade chat. The door now takes image/jpeg, image/png and image/webp in `file` as well as a PDF, sent as an image block, picture first then the question, with the media_type the app chose going upstream rather than guessed from the bytes. HEIC IS NOT ACCEPTED and cannot be — the Messages API does not take it as base64 — so an iPhone photo straight out of a file picker gets its own wording, “send a JPEG, PNG or WebP”, instead of “only a PDF can be sent” over a photograph; the sending app canvas-exports a JPEG first. The 5 MB limit and the 200-a-day household cap are unchanged and a photo costs one slot like a PDF; the size check still sits ABOVE the counter so an oversized photo is refused without spending one, which was only true by accident of ordering before and now has a test. THE CONFIRM SHEET NAMES IT: it said “(PDF, 380 KB)” for anything attached, which over a photograph is a wrong preview, and a wrong preview is worse than none — the same reasoning as when the sheet first learned to name a file. It now reads the kind off the media_type: “receipt.jpg (photo, 380 KB)”, and “a photo” where the sender passes no name. Swept to all 55 apps, v76 → v77. NO VERSION STAMP BUMPED, same reasoning as #543. CHECKS: tools/ai-door/test.mjs 43 passing, up from 27; tools/house/test.cjs has an eighth group, filekind, which drives the real sheet in a real browser against a stood-in door — 42 passing, up from 38, and putting the old sheet back in one app fails two of its four. NOT TESTABLE FROM A CLOUD CHAT: whether the door really reads a receipt. THE ONE THING OUTSTANDING: the Worker only changes when Jerry redeploys daraja-ai-door on Cloudflare, so until he does, a photo still comes back 415. The one-screen deploy step went to the front door on 21 Nov to hand him. Truck & Trade was told it can call djAI.ask with `file`, falling back to the phone’s reader when the door is off. 21 NOV, HOME SCREEN TILES (#543). iOS does not render SVG for <link rel=“apple-touch-icon”>, so 28 apps had a BLANK tile — found by the Pit Wall chat (#535), and it undercut the Home Screen row shipped hours earlier in v74. Three more than the relay listed: builtonfaith, business-manager-ke, try. Each app’s own icon.svg is now rendered to a 180x180 icon-180.png by tools/icons/make.cjs (start|one app|--check), which paints the icon’s own background first so there is no transparency for iOS to show black through, and REFUSES a render with no ink rather than writing it — a blank PNG looks exactly like the bug. IT CAUGHT TWO: Our Table’s 🍽 and Feedback Studio’s 🎙 came out as dark monochrome glyphs, near invisible, because those characters default to a TEXT presentation and need U+FE0F; of 30 character-built icons only one had it. Both icon.svg files now carry it. NOT DONE DELIBERATELY: the relay asked to bump each app’s version stamp. The number belongs to that app’s chat — it is in their cards and spoken in their videos — and moving 28 from here would collide with their numbering for a change no tester can see in the app. board.py checks the icon itself, not the stamp: control/launch.json went from 25 red for ‘home icon’ to none, 34 of 38 ready. 21 NOV, THE SAME-LOOK HOUSE FINDINGS (#541, house v76). Four were relayed; each was measured before anything changed, and they did not all hold. TAP SIZE — FIXED: daraja-readable-v4-css set nav/pills/chips/tabs to min-height 40px with a comment calling it “still a comfortable target”, while everything else in the house is 44. Raised in all 26 apps carrying it; measured at 390px, FlipKit 40→44 and My Safety Plan 43→44, nothing else moved, no new overflow. THE GREETING — FIXED, AND WORSE THAN REPORTED: it covered the app’s OWN NAME in 39 of the 43 apps that show it, most completely, for the whole 8 seconds. It now starts just below the header where there is one near the top; still floats, so nothing jumps when it goes (which is what v62 fixed). 39 covered → 4, and those only ~25%. VIEWPORT-FIT=COVER — FIXED: five apps still lacked it (the store and the front door among them) so env(safe-area-inset-*) read 0. A console warning was suggested; a repo check is better, so tools/house/test.cjs now fails if any app is missing it. feedback-studio was fixed by its own chat mid-flight and that version was kept. THE DOCK — HALF REAL, DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED. The mid-page half IS real: all seven named apps reproduce plus help and start, so at first open the ? sits on a visible tappable control in 9 of 54, and Receipt Maker’s × loses about half its area. The END-OF-PAGE half is NOT real — I built the bottom-room fix, then measured with and without it: zero overlaps either way. The two apps that looked trapped were buttons inside a CLOSED <details>, which still report a box; any scan without a visibility test will see them. The fix was removed rather than shipped, since it would have put a body::after into 55 apps for nothing. Nothing is unreachable — all 9 clear with a flick — and nudging the dock would make it jump as you scroll, which is worse. tools/house/test.cjs now has 7 groups, 38 passing. 21 NOV, SAFE ROLLOUT — IDEA 9 (#529, house v75). Its dependency was “a decision on how the test copy is served”; the decision, the reasoning and the tool are in control/launch-plan.md under idea 9. THE FINDING: nothing can be held back from one person and not another — Pages serves one copy of main to everybody and there is no server to ask who is visiting. Holding it in the service worker was rejected on measurement: 34 different sw.js files, one per app, each owned by that app’s chat, and the common shape is network-first so it serves the newest at once; worse, a worker that wrongly never updates strands every customer with no way to push a fix. SO: the new version goes to <app>/beta/, a byte-identical copy, and moves to the real address when it has earned it — “held back” just means the released file has not changed yet. tools/rollout.js start|list|promote|drop, with promote refusing before 24h unless --now. The house (v75) recognises <app>/beta/, uses the PARENT folder as the slug so the tester’s saved work, backup entry, tour and Home Screen record still belong to the same app (without it a beta calls itself an app named “beta” and opens empty), and shows a band along the BOTTOM saying it is not released, with a way back — the bottom because the greeting card floats over the top on purpose (v62) and the first attempt sat on it. tools/house/test.cjs has a sixth group, beta: 8 checks that make a real beta, drive it, confirm the 24h refusal and clean up.
